Charging

Charging an Ather in Chennai

Most of it happens while you sleep. The rest is a ten-minute stop on the way somewhere. Here is what that actually looks like day to day.

Home charging

At home, overnight

A normal 5A socket and the charger in the box. Plug in at night, full by morning — roughly 5 to 8 hours depending on the pack. This is how 90% of charging happens.

Ather Grid

Ather Grid, on the way

Public fast chargers around the city. About 30 km of range in ten minutes on the 450 — enough to turn a coffee stop into a top-up.

Duo charger

A second charger

The Ather Duo charger for the office or a second home. Cheaper than the anxiety of planning around one socket.

Living with it

The honest version

You will not charge every day

A 20 km commute on the 3.5 kWh pack means charging roughly twice a week. Most owners settle into plugging in on a Sunday and a Wednesday and stop thinking about it.

Apartment parking is the real question

If you can reach a socket in your parking spot, you are set. If not, talk to us before you buy — we have worked through this with a lot of Chennai buyers and there are usually options.

Fast charging is for exceptions

It is there for the day you forgot, or the ride to Puducherry. Using it occasionally is fine; using it daily is not how the pack likes to live.

Your electricity bill will move a little

A full charge is a few units. Against a petrol scooter it is not close — that is the single biggest running-cost difference, and it shows up every month.

Planning a route? Tell us where you ride and we will show you the Ather Grid points on it before you buy, not after. The live map lives in the Ather app.
Ask us

Not sure charging will work where you live?

It is the most common worry and usually the easiest to solve. Tell us your parking situation.
